cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Who Changed It?
cards.instruction: Ask innocent questions until someone admits altering the plan, schedule, arrangement, or shared space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The picnic is now on Friday. Before we notify anyone, whose blue pen made that change on the calendar?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Ownership is not authorship. Who puts a little heart over the 'i' in 'Friday'?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I do. I moved it because Saturday looked wet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. A changed date and a notified guest list are separate jobs. Which Saturday guests have you told, precisely?

reason: Make A correct the evidentiary distinction after B shared-pen defence, then use the admitted change for a precise follow-up question about notification.
